resolution: AtomisticCausalSource uses G as a candidate COMPLETE existence-producing relation, not a partial contributor or the world-local grounds field. Rutten's one-cause-per-effect concerns incoming complete causes; a cause may have many effects. Joint contributors can be only part of a complete source. Constitutive grounds can overlap their whole and do not automatically satisfy complete-production nonoverlap. No relation inclusion, actuality, inverse mapping or necessity bridge is inferred from names.
